title: InfiniteItems
description: ♾️ InfiniteItems gives you unlimited pearls 🧿, rockets 🚀, food 🍖, and more for smooth gameplay! creating!
body:
🔥 InfiniteItems – The Ultimate Infinite Items Plugin! ♾️

With InfiniteItems, you can create and manage truly endless items straight from an intuitive GUI menu 🖥️. Whether it’s 🧿 Ender Pearls, 🚀 Firework Rockets, 💧 Water Buckets, 🍗 Food, or any other consumable – this plugin makes sure you never run out again!

✨ Key Features

🎨 Easy-to-use GUI – Create infinite items with just a few clicks!

🧰 Infinite consumables – Pearls, rockets, buckets, food, and more stay unlimited forever.

⚡ Commands support – Quickly give infinite items to yourself or others.

🛠️ Fully customizable – Edit and manage your infinite items directly from the GUI.

🤝 Perfect for servers – Great for creative servers, practice PvP, minigames, or just fun gameplay!

🚀 Why InfiniteItems?

Forget about refilling stacks over and over. With this plugin, items never decrease when used, giving your players a smooth, hassle-free experience. Whether it’s PvP battles, flying with rockets, or constant clutching with pearls, InfiniteItems has you covered.

♾️ Infinite fun, Infinite freedom – InfiniteItems!
